examples.name: bluekrabsetw
examples.description: bluekrabsetw is a C++ library that simplifies interacting with ETW. It allows for any number of traces and providers to be enabled and for client code to register for event notifications from these traces. bluekrabsetw originates from the krabsetw c++ library and seeks to improve and include capabilities that have not yet been included in the former library.

examples.name: Weasel Alpha
examples.description: Weasel is a powerful and extensible high-speed Windows logging and threat-detection framework designed for threat hunters seeking in-depth records of process behavior enriched with contextual information, built-in detection of advanced malware techniques, and low performance overhead. In order to contribute, you first need to register via the form. After registration, you’ll gain access to the dedicated GitHub repository and Discord channel where collaboration takes place [Form](https://test.de).

examples.name: Laurel
examples.description: LAUREL is an event post-processing plugin for auditd(8) that generates useful, enriched JSON-based audit logs suitable for modern security monitoring setups.
